scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run build:worlds && bun run typecheck:worlds && bun run test
scripts.build: bun run --filter @brickkit/core build && bun run --filter @brickkit/crud build && bun run --filter @brickkit/cli build
scripts.test: bun test packages examples/extensions/test examples/websocket/test scripts --path-ignore-patterns='**/*-world/**' && bun run --cwd examples/events test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @brickkit/core typecheck && bun run --filter @brickkit/crud typecheck && bun run --filter @brickkit/cli typecheck && bun run --filter @brickkit/workflow-inspector typecheck
scripts.check:www: bun run build && bun run --cwd www lint && bun run --cwd www types:check && bun run --cwd www docs:check
scripts.pages:dev: bun run build && bun run --cwd examples/pages dev
scripts.pages:test: bun run build && bun run --cwd examples/pages test
scripts.pages:typecheck: bun run build && bun run --cwd examples/pages typecheck
scripts.pages:build: bun run build && bun run --cwd examples/pages build
